# qrcode-generator 2.0.4, vendored

Copied unedited on 17 November 2026 by dev@PrompTugal.dinis from this repository's `newsroom/tools/vendor/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.mjs` (the ES module build of Kazuhiko Arase's qrcode-generator, npm `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`), so the pairing page (`/account/pair.html`, `assets/vault/pair.js`) can draw its QR code in the browser.
